name: Jeld-Wen 3737 Lakeport

nadir.desc: The property consists of a commercial building with a blue sloped roof on the street side and white flat-roof sections behind|A large paved parking lot with marked spaces and tree islands sits along the public road|A paved service drive wraps the rear and sides|Open lawn occupies the front corners

alpha.desc: The front of the building faces Lakeport Blvd with a blue sloped roof, a paved parking lot, and trees along the lot|The street-facing elevation includes a visible entry area|White flat-roof sections extend behind the blue roof|Open lawn sits at both ends of the lot|Campus buildings and storage yards are visible beyond the site.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows the blue sloped roof, the white flat-roof warehouse section, and the paved parking lot|Open lawn runs along this side|A paved drive continues toward the rear service yard.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows white flat-roof sections, overhead doors, and a paved service yard|Equipment and stored materials occupy portions of the rear lot|A paved drive wraps the building|Open ground sits beyond the service yard|The blue sloped roof remains visible on the street side.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows the blue sloped roof, white flat-roof sections, and the paved parking lot along the street|A service drive and rear yard are visible behind the structure|Neighboring campus storage and buildings continue beyond the site|Trees line the parking lot.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from Lakeport Blvd into a large front parking lot and from campus drives into a rear service yard. The site is a mixed office and warehouse building on the north end of the Jeld-Wen campus. A golf course and water body sit beyond the plant. Railroad corridors and other industrial sites sit across Lakeport Blvd. The front lot provides staging space. The rear yard includes overhead doors and stored materials that may affect movement.
